title: Dinosaur Descendants
content: "A new study comparing the genomes of birds suggests that, genetically speaking, the turkey and the chicken is closer to its dinosaur ancestors than any other bird is."—Jennifer Ackerman, "The Genius of Birds."Thestudy referencedby M.N. Romanov et al, BMC Genomics, 2014, also cites the the chicken as being very closely related.
